Shipping policy What shipping options do you have?
We primarily ship from our facility in Oakland, CA.
Cuyana ships Monday through Friday, except for US federal holidays .
Domestic Orders (Economy): We offer No Rush shipping to the contiguous US.

No Rush shipping typically takes 2-10 business days for arrival after processing.

Orders under $95 have a $5 shipping fee.
Domestic Orders (Guaranteed): We offer Standard shipping to the entirety of the US for $10.
Standard shipping typically takes 1-5 business days for arrival after processing.

Orders must be received before 11am PT for same day processing, the order will deliver the following business day by 8 pm.
International Orders: We offer International Expedited shipping via Passport Global for all international addresses.
Shipping fees vary by destination country and will be displayed at checkout.
Duties and taxes are included in the shipping cost and will be clearly listed at checkout.
All international orders are shipped delivery duties paid (DDP).

Any changes to shipping addresses or shipping speed will require us to cancel the order and return the package to us.
If you require re-routing or holding of your package once shipped, please contact the carrier directly.

We do not ship with signature required so please make arrangements for safe arrival of your parcel.
Our carriers do not ship on some federal holidays.
Please see FedEx's delivery schedule and UPS's delivery schedule for more information.

Shipping policy Shipping & Delivery Policy This Shipping & Delivery Policy forms part of our Terms & Conditions of Sale and should be read together with them and with our Returns, Exchanges & Refunds Policy.
To contact us about an order or delivery, please email help@allbirds.co.uk or call +1 424 644 1644.
Where We Deliver 2.1 We currently accept orders for delivery to eligible addresses within the United Kingdom, the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man.
We do not deliver to other destinations through the Website unless otherwise indicated at checkout.
2.2 Delivery to certain remote or rural areas, including parts of the Scottish Highlands and Islands, Northern Ireland and offshore territories, may take longer than the delivery estimates stated in this policy.
Certain delivery services may also be unavailable to some postcodes.
2.3 To the extent permitted by applicable law, we may decline or cancel orders placed for delivery to PO Boxes, BFPO addresses, parcel or freight forwarding services, or addresses that we reasonably believe present a fraud, security, safety or delivery risk.
2.4 If we are unable to deliver to the address you have provided, we will contact you where reasonably possible and provide any refund or other remedy required under applicable law.
Fulfilment and Carriers 3.1 Orders may be picked, packed and dispatched by third-party fulfilment partners and delivered by third-party carriers acting on our behalf.
3.2 We may select the fulfilment location, carrier, delivery route and delivery method used to complete your order.
Orders may be dispatched from one or more of our fulfilment centres or retail stores and may be split into multiple shipments.
3.3 We may use a different carrier from the carrier identified at checkout or in your confirmation email where reasonably necessary, provided that the substituted service is of a broadly equivalent standard and does not materially reduce the delivery service you selected or affect your statutory rights.
4.2 Orders placed after 2pm, or on a day that is not a business day, may be treated as received on the next business day for the purposes of processing and calculating applicable delivery estimates.
4.3 We aim to process and dispatch orders as quickly as reasonably possible.
4.5 Once your order has been dispatched, we will normally send you a shipping confirmation email containing tracking information where available.
Delivery Services, Charges and Estimated Timescales 5.1 The delivery services and charges currently available are: Standard Delivery Estimated delivery time: 1–5 business days.
Orders under £45.00: £4.95 Orders of £45.00 or more: FREE 5.2 Available delivery services and charges are displayed at checkout before you place your order and may vary depending on your delivery address, order value and the Products in your order.
Delivery charges displayed at checkout are inclusive of VAT where VAT is applicable.
5.3 The delivery estimates above are calculated from the date your order is treated as received under clause 4.2, unless a different timeframe is expressly displayed at checkout.
5.4 Delivery times are estimates only unless we have expressly agreed a guaranteed delivery date with you.
Delivery may occasionally be affected by circumstances outside our reasonable control, including carrier disruption, severe weather, public holidays, unusually high order volumes, customs delays or other events described in clause 12.
5.5 We may change our delivery services, charges, delivery thresholds and estimated timescales from time to time.
The delivery options and charges that apply to your order are those displayed at checkout when you place your order.
Unless we have agreed otherwise with you, we will deliver your order without undue delay and in any event within 30 days of the date on which the Contract is formed.
If we fail to deliver within that period, you may have the right to specify an additional reasonable period for delivery and, if we still fail to deliver, to cancel the Contract and receive a refund.
Where delivery within a particular period was expressly agreed as essential before the Contract was formed, or where it was clear from the circumstances that delivery by a particular time was essential, you may have additional rights under applicable law.
Delivery Address and Customer Responsibilities 6.1 You are responsible for providing a complete, accurate and up-to-date delivery address, telephone number and email address when placing your order.
You are also responsible for providing any information reasonably required to complete delivery, including apartment or unit numbers, entry codes, concierge or reception details and relevant access restrictions.
6.2 If you notice an error in your delivery information, please contact us as soon as possible.
We cannot guarantee that an address can be changed once an order has entered processing or has been dispatched.
